title: Starter Pearl
description: Adds a reverse Ender Pearl item
body:
# Starter Pearl Mod

_"A strange item. It seems to come from a place of abundant light. Perhaps a negative space of some sort."_

- This is a more polished, standalone version of the Starter Pearl item from the [Start Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-start-mod), for anyone who wishes to use this unique item without the rest of the Start Mod's other features.  
- The mod only adds the Starter Pearl, which can now be crafted using an Ender Pearl and glowstone dust.  
- The Starter Pearl is an "inverse Ender Pearl", drawing any hit player to the Starter Pearl's thrower.

Technical details:
- The Starter Pearl functions by teleporting the nearest player within a 2 block radius of the Starter Pearl's landing site to the player who threw the Pearl. This also enables the usage of "Starter Pearl stasis chambers" (functionally the same as an Ender Pearl stasis chamber), which can be used to teleport a player to the Pearl's original owner upon activation.



## _WARNING_
Do **not** attempt to use this mod alongside the [Start Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-start-mod).

## Notes
If any bugs are encountered, please report them directly to me on Discord at 'watchernovius'. Suggestions, improvements, and bugfixes are welcome.
